asr_text: Six steps to a complete 11 labs voice agent, here's the plan. Create the agent, write a first message and prompt, add a knowledge base. Connect a webhook tool, put it on a Twilio number, then test. Tell the prompt exactly when to use each tool. Add an evaluation criterion and a data item, so every call gets graded. Then monitor your first few calls in calls history. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 33.
